name: Lying Chest Pass Med Ball Throw
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Explosively press the ball straight up.
Catch the ball with soft elbows.
Immediately bring it back to your chest and repeat.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A lying explosive chest pass that trains upper-body power with a medicine ball.
